findings.friction_name: persona detours through an unexpected account-type modal before completing plan selection
findings.narrative: free-tier-user detoured through the account-type modal via a direct signup click; willing-to-pay-user reached the identical modal via a back-navigation retry — a structurally different DOM path. Despite the differing paths, both records correctly compute step=2, the index of the NEXT not-yet-completed happy-path step at the time the detour occurred (last_completed_step=1), never the index of the last-completed step (F147, CR3-2). Because both records share the identical (heuristic_tag, step, target_element_identifier) tuple, they correctly merge into one finding at convergence_tier=2 — the exact corroboration the F45/F92 identity tuple exists to produce.
